People Ops: Quick announcement — short attestation + evidence window opens today to close remaining SOC2/ISO artifacts. Please complete the 7-min Data Handling attestation and upload any missing evidence by Wednesday 11:59pm PT. We'll publish an exec-friendly risk summary after collection.

People Ops: What we need (fast): 1) Complete the attestation: https://internal.redwood/attest-2026 2) Upload evidence or an "in-progress" placeholder per control: https://internal.redwood/forms/comp-upload 3) Managers: verify your team's items in the verification flow. Office hours Thurs 10:00-12:00 PT.

Dev A.: Quick Q — I have a short-lived analytics job that pulled telemetry. Do I need to sign and upload?

People Ops: If the job touched telemetry or customer data and had access to prod, yes. If it was ephemeral and never on the access roster, mark "exclude" and cc People Ops. When in doubt, attest and add a short note.

Security Lead: Reminder on artifact naming: use redwood_evidence_<team>_<control>_<YYYYMMDD>.zip. Console screenshots + job IDs are fine as placeholders with ETA.

Manager Zoe: Will missing placeholders block releases?

Security Lead: Not automatically. High-risk gaps (auth/audit/incident-response) will be escalated to engineering leadership. Routine placeholders ok if marked and ETA provided.

compliance-bot: Reminder queued — 48 hours left before deadline. Incomplete items will appear in the weekly risk digest.

People Ops: Thanks all — ping the thread if you need help or drop into office hours. We'll post a short digest for execs after verification completes.
